prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET: FatMatryoshka flat cut-paper logo. Preserve its coral outer open doll, teal middle open doll, friendly faces, two short exterior audio-jack leads, ivory rims, and two nested lower bowls. Widen the middle shell and bowls enough to hold the two small dolls comfortably. Each little cobalt-blue doll has exactly TWO small ivory circular jacks, one on its left and one on its right. CRITICAL ROUTING: leftmost jack (left small doll's left jack) is connected by a plain dark curved cable to the INSIDE underside of the teal parent top shell. Rightmost jack (right small doll's right jack) is connected by another plain dark curved cable to the INSIDE underside of the same teal parent top shell. The two inward-facing jacks (right jack of left doll and left jack of right doll) are connected directly to EACH OTHER by ONE short visible U-shaped dark cable in the gap between them. No other connection from those inner jacks to the parent. Keep both coral-to-teal parent-child cables, attached to the teal TOP exterior jacks and originating INSIDE the coral top. No cables attached to any bowl. Exactly FOUR dolls total: coral parent, teal middle, two cobalt-blue siblings. Keep progressively simpler friendly faces. Style: genuinely flat cut-paper shapes, single solid coral #e7775d, teal #287d80, cobalt-blue #3559a6, ivory #fff7e8 and dark #171f21 fills, crisp clean edges, NO gradients, texture, glows, shadows, black outer outlines or highlights. Transparent background, generous margin, no text. Clear visible separation between all shells and two cobalt-blue dolls. Keep composition compact and balanced. IMPORTANT COLOR CHANGE: both smallest dolls MUST be saturated medium-dark cobalt blue #3559a6, NEVER yellow or gold. Use small ivory face patches with dark eyes and mouth, ivory jack rings, to read clearly against blue. Gold is permitted ONLY for exterior metal plug tips.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this image ONLY to simplify its faces and make all fills truly flat. Preserve ALL doll silhouettes, positions, all jack rings, all cable routes, especially the U-shaped connection directly between the two blue siblings, and transparent background. CRITICAL: REMOVE BOTH IVORY FACE DISCS FROM THE TWO SMALLEST BLUE DOLLS. Fill those disc areas with exactly the same cobalt-blue as their bodies. Each tiny blue doll has ONLY TWO SMALL IVORY DOT EYES directly on its blue body, NO FACE PATCH, NO MOUTH, NO HAIR. The middle teal doll keeps its ivory face disc but has ONLY TWO DARK DOT EYES, no smile, no hair. The large coral parent keeps existing ivory face, hair, eyes, smile. This hierarchy is essential: parent most detailed; middle simpler; smallest almost abstract. Small ivory CIRCULAR JACK RINGS must stay exactly as they are; only face discs are removed on the small blue dolls. All colored shapes must be flat single solid fills with absolutely NO gradient, shadow, texture, glow, highlights or 3D lighting. Do not alter any geometry or topology. Transparent background.
notes: Two blue siblings; outer jacks connect to the teal parent; inner jacks connect directly. Smallest faces are two ivory eyes without face discs. Generated raster retains slight tonal variation.
